versions.name: Cybersecurity
versions.description: Map your own attack surface, spot phishing and spoofed sites, harden accounts with strong passwords and multi-factor authentication, and see encryption and hashing at work while learning why confidentiality, integrity, and availability drive every defense.

provenance.notes: Introduced 2025. Confirmed by the project owner and corroborated by the merit-badge ranking series, which places the badge in 2025 and nowhere earlier: Scouting America's 2025 recap gives it the 999 'no prior rank' sentinel for 2024.
